summary.en: Use natural offline dialogue references and expose distinct strategy categories with truthful trade-offs in choice metadata.
summary.zh: 离线发言改用自然引用，并为选项提供不同策略分类与真实代价说明。

reason: User-facing offline speech changes and additive menu metadata, also used by the experimental Android companion added in the same PR.

compatibility.en: No save/config schema change. Structured source IDs and option IDs remain; old saved utterances are not rewritten. New menu metadata does not enter accepted speech payloads.
compatibility.zh: 存档与配置格式不变，保留结构化来源编号和选项编号；旧存档发言不重写，新增菜单说明不进入已接受发言内容。
